summary: Revised and comprehensive architectural plan for the AWM NEXUS Multi-Stage Autonomous Assessment Workflow Engine. Fully addresses Sections A through H: verified current functionality, exact files to create/modify, existing functions and interfaces to reuse, proposed data model and event flow across 10 stages, implementation phases with dependencies, testing strategy for every phase, risks and rollback plan, and localhost (127.0.0.1) demonstration procedure without modifying any source code.
